item.title: Musk: “Woke Programming Is Everywhere in Children’s ‘Educational Shows’” - Even Peppa Pig
item.description: Musk: “Woke Programming Is Everywhere in Children’s ‘Educational Shows’” - Even Peppa Pig “Woke programming is everywhere in children’s ‘educational shows’ and books,” billionaire technological visionary Elon Musk warned Thursday, reacting to a video clip from the popular cartoon for preschoolers, Peppa Pig. “They are trying to feed woke poison to your children without you knowing it. Who would guess that simple cartoons like Peppa Pig were being used for indoctrination?” @XFreeze wrote on X.com
